commits.subject: [AUDIT FIX] m16 + m17 two screens told the reader something that was not true: a value that is both unknown and incomplete rendered as the literal string '—+' on public/app/finance-os.html and banking-surface.html, because the ROW gets is-partial from basis.partial while the VALUE gets is-unknown from display === null, and src/finance/os-grid.mjs sets both at once whenever every line had a hole — sumKnown() returns total:null when nothing was usable (os-grid.mjs:79) while basisOf() still reports partial:true because unknown > 0 (os-grid.mjs:86) — so a client whose tradelines report no credit limit at all got a floor marker stacked on an em dash, and the plus means 'there is more than this', which is meaningless attached to 'we have no number'; :not(.is-unknown) drops only that pair and both signals still work where each is true; and public/app/data.js:83 reported every non-ok body as fail('nodb'), announcing a 500 out of netlify/functions/api.mjs:327 or :334 — our own code throwing or failing to answer — to the user as the database being unreachable, sending whoever is called to check Postgres while the fault is in the function logs, so the front end now claims only what it can observe at that point (the server ran, chose a status and wrote a reply) and does not guess WHY, because api.mjs:334 wraps every thrown error identically and a database error is among them
